description: This file defines the FastAPI router for handling data assets in a data insights dashboard backend. It provides API endpoints for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving data assets with associated business logic, validation, authorization, and audit support.

methods.name: create_data_asset( request: CreateDataAssetRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new data asset with standard metadata and initiate validation.

methods.name: get_data_asset( data_asset_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve details of a specific data asset by ID, including validation status.

methods.name: trigger_validation( data_asset_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger a validation run for a data asset.

methods.name: approve_data_asset( data_asset_id: str, request: ApproveDataAssetRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to approve or reject a data asset with e-signature, potentially enforcing SoD policies.

ctags.signature: ( data_asset_id: str, request: ApproveDataAssetRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
